clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom, Grommash Hold commands the red cliffs as Thrall's seat. Named for Grommash Hellscream's sacrifice, it is the political heart of the new Horde.

Grommash Hold rises from the cliffs of the Valley of Wisdom, where Thrall receives emissaries, petitioners, and warlords. Its thick stone halls stay dim and chilly, a choice meant to keep those who attend his audiences alert and sober. Thrall weighs the defense of Kalimdor with veteran counselors such as Eitrigg, while racial chieftains like Vol'jin visit the hold.

Outside the fortress, Mannoroth's shattered armor and horned skull hang from the trunk of an ancient tree. The memorial honors Grom Hellscream, who gave his life to slay the pit lord in Ashenvale. It recalls the orcs' freedom from the demonic blood curse and warns against returning to reckless savagery.
